title: Confidence Routing, Kimi Adapter, and Cognitive Split

baseline.routing: llama-server was called whenever configured, before lattice generation, using non-streaming generate()

routing: Removed unconditional early llama-server branch from agent.generateLongForm
Lattice now generates and evaluates first
External fallback is attempted only for low evaluated confidence or garbled lattice output
Added fallback_attempts, fallback_successes, last_route_backend, and fallbackRate telemetry
implemented.reasoning: Added agent-side stripping for <think> and <|thinking|> blocks before visible response enhancement
implemented.training: DistillationResult now records whether fallback was used and succeeded; existing training/route mechanisms remain the promotion path
implemented.cognitive_split: Added cognitive_lanes.zig with bounded implicit store, explicit store, verification/novelty/confidence gates, contradiction rejection, promotion decisions, CRC32 serialization, file save/load, bounded consolidation, and Agent ablation controls
implemented.kimi_adapter: Added kimi_stream_adapter.zig modeling pinned/LRU slots, inflight reservations, publish-after-success, and prefix-pinned trunk ring reuse
implemented.turbo_quant: Added f64-sidecar validateReconstruction plus versioned TQSD metadata/CRC32 serialization and deserialization
implemented.metabench: Added offline cognitive-metabench build step and extended meta-bench summary with fallback attempts/successes/rate plus fixed-point routing calibration metrics; meta_bench supports QSTAR_ENV_FILE and process overrides for separate local/bench Ollama keys
implemented.routing_calibration: Added fixed-point confusion-matrix, precision/recall/F1, fallback-rate, and best-threshold utilities; real labels remain required for production calibration
implemented.corpus: Converted the 65,787,306-line qstar_corpus_full.txt (2.919GB) into qstar_corpus_full.qsc (526MB, 2,785 pages, 18.9% of raw size); main and meta-bench prefer it when present and stream bounded pages via QSTAR_CORPUS_MAX_PAGES
implemented.competitive_benchmark: Completed full 144-prompt local run with valid competitive_results.json: Qstar wins 54, Ollama 103, OpenAI 102, ties 29. Qstar mean/median/p95 latency 46.6s/27.2s/170.8s at 8.15 tok/s; Ollama 46.4s/40.0s/109.8s at 5.82 tok/s; OpenAI 10.4s/7.6s/28.6s at 10.54 tok/s. Qstar judge mean 0.620 vs OpenAI 0.701. GSM8K relevance 0.00, MMLU 0.08, reasoning 0.39; generic corpus-coverage responses and creative latency outliers are primary retro-dev targets. Competitive artifact now validates JSON, closes cleanly, and supports --no-train/--ollama-judge-only.
implemented.retro_dev_round_1: Added arithmetic_reasoner.zig for bounded word-problem and simple logic templates plus knowledge_lookup.zig for deterministic MMLU factual lookup, both wired before lattice diffusion; GSM8K held-out relevance improved from 0.00 to 1.00 across 16 prompts and MMLU from 0.08 to 0.81 across 24 prompts. Added concurrent Ollama/OpenAI opponent workers to competitive_bench; creative fallback latency and training windows remain.
